  --nues-blue:#3057E1;
  --nues-rail:#D0D3DD;
  --nues-rail-gap:2px;
  --nues-rail-h:4px;
  --nues-thumb:16px;
  --nues-radius:999px;
}

.nues-slider{ max-width:420px; width:100%; margin:auto; }
.nues-track{ position:relative; height:var(--nues-thumb); }

.nues-segments{
  position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%);
  height:var(--nues-rail-h);
  display:grid; align-items:center;
  z-index:0; column-gap:var(--nues-rail-gap);
}
.nues-segments > div{
  height:var(--nues-rail-h);
  background:var(--nues-rail);
  border-radius:var(--nues-radius);
}

.nues-fill{
  position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%);
  height:var(--nues-rail-h); width:0%;
  background:var(--nues-blue); border-radius:var(--nues-radius);
  z-index:1;
}

.nues-thumb{
  position:absolute; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:var(--nues-thumb); height:var(--nues-thumb);
  border-radius:50%;
  background: radial-gradient(#fff 35%, var(--nues-blue) 36%);
  box-shadow:0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  z-index:2; pointer-events:none;
}

.nues-input{
  position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
  -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none;
  background:transparent; border:none; outline:none;
  z-index:5; cursor:pointer;
}
.nues-input::-webkit-slider-thumb{ -webkit-appearance:none; width:var(--nues-thumb); height:var(--nues-thumb); background:transparent; border:none; }

  transition: background-color .22s ease;

  transition: right .22s ease, transform .22s ease;
}

#period-toggle.is-monthly{
  background: #7D829433;      /* tražena siva/transparentna */
}
#period-toggle.is-monthly .white-circle-togle{
  right: 20px;                 /* kako si tražio: gore/dole 0, desno 20px */
}

#period-toggle.toogle-yearly:active .white-circle-togle{
  transform: scale(.95);
}

/* accessibility: bez animacija ako user ne želi */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  #period-toggle.toogle-yearly,
  #period-toggle.toogle-yearly .white-circle-togle{
    transition: none;
  }
}
